context: Review 2.4 and 2.5. Three list pages shared one idea, and the Ask box sat on the least visited of them.
decision: One /knowledge page with Notes, Decisions and File cards tabs. Old /notes, /decisions and /memory redirect. The Ask box is removed from File cards; search shows an "Ask: <text>" row that calls recall. Copy as Markdown went with it. Virtualising the lists (4.3) was not done: show() finds a record by DOM id.
title: Notes, Decisions and Memory are one Knowledge page; the Ask box moved into search
